outlook.statement: Global growth projected to moderate to around 3.1% in 2026; Indian economy GDP growth for FY 2026-27 projected at 6.9% with inflation at 4.6%; NBFC sector remains resilient with strong capital buffers and improving asset quality.
The management is optimistic about the future outlook of the Company. The Company will expand its activities, consistent with its status as a NBFC.

risks: Market risk from significant quoted investments exposed to stock price fluctuations
Liquidity risk from asset-liability mismatches
Interest rate volatility
Execution risk
Economic cycle risk
Adverse movements in financial markets or investee company operations

The Company is exposed to interest rate risk due to fluctuations in market interest rates, which can impact the returns on its interest-earning investments and the valuation of fixed-income securities.
While the Indian economy has shown sustained growth over the last several years, a slowdown could cause the business of the Company to suffer.

The Company has established a well-documented and robust risk management framework. The Board of Directors of the Company has adopted the Risk Management policy which involves identification and prioritization of risk events, categorization of risk into high, medium and low based on the business impact and likelihood of occurrence of risks and risk mitigation and control measures.
